channel.title: ResponderTX · Flood Ops
channel.description: Flood warnings, watches and advisories, flash flood emergencies, forecast river crests, and active notices for Texas. Situational awareness, not a dispatch system; call 911 for emergencies.

item.title: Flood Warning · Nueces River near Tilden
item.description: Flood Warning issued November 13 at 8:17AM CST until November 18 at 2:00PM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX. In effect until Nov 18, 2:00 PM CT. Areas: McMullen. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.
